# Awesome Agent Skills by Suede

Find a skill for the work in front of you. Browse **2,975 accepted skills from 140 repositories**, organized into **16 categories**, with source links, publisher credits and verified structural quality scores.

The GitHub companion to the [Agent Skills Directory](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/), maintained by [Jason Colapietro / Suede AI](https://suedeai.ai/founder). Coverage follows the directory’s accepted snapshot and editorial rules. The [Suede Creator Skills pack](../README.md) has its own installation guide.

**[Browse categories](#contents)** · **[Browse publishers](publishers.md)** · **[Featured projects](featured.md)** · **[Search on Suede](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/)** · **[Contribute](CONTRIBUTING.md)**

Snapshot: **2026-10-17** · Scores: **graded-v2** · [How scores work](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/methodology/).

## Featured projects

- **[Appie](featured.md#appie)** by [appierun](https://github.com/appierun). Bring Appie’s writing, chatbot and link tools into your agent workflow. Pick the skill for the job and follow its individual setup instructions.
- **[CoalWash](featured.md#coalwash)** by [TheColliery](https://github.com/TheColliery). Measure memory and governance-file overhead, run maintenance, and inspect the changes. CoalWash pairs a structured-token guard with transaction snapshots and rollback tools.

These 2 editorial selections have [reviewed scope and setup guidance](featured.md). Editorial selection is separate from quality scores, security certification and README-badge verification. Featured plugins outside the scored skill snapshot are not included in the skill or repository counts above.

## Read a listing

- **Skill name** opens its upstream `SKILL.md`. Publisher headings link to the source repository and team.
- **Description** uses the saved editorial summary when available, otherwise a short excerpt from the publisher’s saved description. Open **Suede** for the complete record and installation guidance.
- **Score / 100 · grade** is recomputed from the saved evidence using the existing [Suede Skill Check](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/methodology/). Published scores range from 0 to 99; 100 is reserved. A = 90–99, B = 80–89, C = 70–79, D = 0–69. Listing eligibility and quality-badge eligibility remain separate.
- **License: … (review terms)** identifies entries whose recorded license is not an open license. Check the source license and publisher’s supported install route before copying.

Scores measure structural evidence, not runtime performance. External listings have security status `not_scanned`; Suede’s own CI scan supplies no security result for them. Read the source, permissions and prerequisites before enabling a skill. Use the project-specific route for plugins that require hooks or an engine; [CoalWash’s complete plugin setup](featured.md#coalwash) preserves those components.

## Contribute and update

[Request an addition, correction or removal](https://github.com/JasonColapietro/suede-creator-skills/issues/new?template=directory-listing.yml) with the repository and exact skills in scope. See [contribution and regeneration instructions](CONTRIBUTING.md) for the acceptance rules, local build and freshness checks.

```sh
npm run build:awesome
npm run test:awesome
node scripts/build-awesome-directory.mjs --check
```

These commands read local data only. CI rejects missing, stale or orphaned generated pages. The existing directory refresh also regenerates this catalog; new publisher content still goes through the directory’s allowlists, exclusions and review process.
